snippet.title: Dadi Kingdom – Official Trailer | You ARE the King (Medieval Fantasy RPG)
snippet.description:
You don't serve the king. You ARE the king. 👑

Dadi Kingdom is a medieval fantasy RPG where your word is law. Every day your people step before the throne — and you decide their fate: release, gold fine, or dungeon. Every verdict has consequences.

⚔️ Pass judgment on your people — mercy or dungeon, your choice matters
🏰 Explore an open world: misty forests, desert lands, an ancient volcano
🧙 Choose your path: the mages grant magic, the church grants archery — you can't have both
🐉 Send your dragons on adventures
🛡️ Fight with sword and shield and grow stronger through quests
👑 Found a dynasty: raise heirs and see how many generations your bloodline survives

At the end, your reign is measured: days ruled, generations, heroic deeds.

🔗 Wishlist Dadi Kingdom on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4166450/
